parserTest0.description: Single WRITELN expression. Smoke-test that the parser drives the WRITELN production and prints the number.

parserTest1.description: Operator precedence across *, /. Three WRITELN lines exercising left-associative * and /, including a parenthesised sub-expression.

parserTest2.description: Mixed + and * precedence. Three WRITELN lines that fail unless the parser distinguishes term-level vs. expression-level operators.

parserTest3.description: Nested BEGIN/END blocks containing WRITELN statements; tests block-statement parsing recursion.

parserTest4.description: Assignment + variable use + arithmetic + WRITELN inside a BEGIN/END block; the program defines x and y then prints x * y.
